Supernova/AGN feedback regulate star formation, redistribute gas, and help reproduce observed stellar-to-halo mass relations, metallicities, and sizes.

Supernova/AGN feedback regulate star formation, redistribute gas, and help reproduce observed stellar-to-halo mass relations, metallicities, and sizes.

Supernova/AGN feedback regulate star formation, redistribute gas, and help reproduce observed stellar-to-halo mass relations, metallicities, and sizes.

Supernova/AGN feedback regulate star formation, redistribute gas, and help reproduce observed stellar-to-halo mass relations, metallicities, and sizes.

Supernova/AGN feedback regulate star formation, redistribute gas, and help reproduce observed stellar-to-halo mass relations, metallicities, and sizes.
